_meta.description: Storage-conscious multilingual RAG mapping. The canonical chunk text is stored once in content as semantic_text. Lexical BM25 fields are generated by the ingest pipeline and excluded from _source.
_meta.chunking: Automatic semantic_text chunking is disabled because the service already indexes pre-chunked records.
_meta.lexical_routing: The ingest pipeline detects language and copies content into exactly one content_lex.<lang> field for language-specific BM25 analysis.

pipeline.description: Detect chunk language, route canonical content into one language-specific lexical field, normalize RAG metadata, and remove deprecated duplicated semantic fields.

script.description: Normalize metadata copied from parser output into indexed top-level fields.
script.source: if (ctx.record_type == null) { ctx.record_type = 'chunk'; } if (ctx.chunking_strategy == null && ctx.chunker_strategy != null) { ctx.chunking_strategy = ctx.chunker_strategy; } if (ctx.metadata != null) { if (ctx.headings == null && ctx.metadata.headings != null) { ctx.headings = ctx.metadata.headings; } if (ctx.page_count == null && ctx.metadata.page_count != null) { ctx.page_count = ctx.metadata.page_count; } if (ctx.chunking_strategy == null && ctx.metadata.chunking_strategy != null) { ctx.chunking_strategy = ctx.metadata.chunking_strategy; } if (ctx.input_format == null && ctx.metadata.input_format != null) { ctx.input_format = ctx.metadata.input_format; } if (ctx.parser == null && ctx.metadata.parser != null) { ctx.parser = ctx.metadata.parser; } if (ctx.pipeline == null && ctx.metadata.pipeline != null) { ctx.pipeline = ctx.metadata.pipeline; } if (ctx.page_start == null && ctx.metadata.page_start != null) { ctx.page_start = ctx.metadata.page_start; } if (ctx.page_end == null && ctx.metadata.page_end != null) { ctx.page_end = ctx.metadata.page_end; } if (ctx.element_types == null && ctx.metadata.element_types != null) { ctx.element_types = ctx.metadata.element_types; } if (ctx.source_file_name == null && ctx.metadata.source_file_name != null) { ctx.source_file_name = ctx.metadata.source_file_name; } } if (ctx.clean_title == null) { if (ctx.headings != null && ctx.headings instanceof List && ctx.headings.size() > 0) { ctx.clean_title = ctx.headings[0]; } else if (ctx.title != null) { ctx.clean_title = ctx.title; } } if (ctx.content != null) { ctx.content_length = ctx.content.length(); } if (ctx.searchable == null) { ctx.searchable = true; } if (ctx.boilerplate == null) { ctx.boilerplate = false; } if (ctx.content_kind == null) { ctx.content_kind = 'unknown'; }

script.description: Choose a supported lexical analyzer field and copy content into exactly one content_lex.<language> field.
script.source: def supported = ['es', 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'pt', 'ca', 'gl']; def lang = null; double prob = 0.0; if (ctx.language_detection != null) { if (ctx.language_detection.predicted_value != null) { lang = ctx.language_detection.predicted_value; } if (ctx.language_detection.top_classes != null && ctx.language_detection.top_classes.size() > 0 && ctx.language_detection.top_classes[0].class_probability != null) { prob = ctx.language_detection.top_classes[0].class_probability; } } if (lang == null || lang == 'zxx' || prob < 0.60 || !supported.contains(lang)) { lang = 'default'; } ctx.language = lang; ctx.language_probability = prob; if (ctx.content != null) { if (ctx.content_lex == null) { ctx.content_lex = new HashMap(); } ctx.content_lex[lang] = ctx.content; }
